intent: A canal neighbourhood that feels grown around streets and shared outdoor spaces rather than repeated shells on a grass plane.
baseline: SPACE09 appearance on the SPACE08 layout; all delivered files preserved.
scope: Same 21 surrounding houses, same developed 72 by 70.5 metre district. No new district roads or distant settlement.
layout: Near east: a narrow two-storey dwelling and a long low workshop share the existing frontage.
North west: a tall residence and low workshop vary the roofline and opening pattern.
North east: the corner house turns toward the side street and leaves a connected corner court.
South west: houses retreat one metre to create a continuous front garden apron.
South middle: two differently oriented houses address a shared 2.6 metre wide court.
South east: low and tall houses mark the end of the street.
Two limited hipped roof treatments change silhouettes without multiplying roof details.
landscape: Four bounded planted parcels in the existing north and south backlands. Low hedges, small planting beds and existing trees make the ground legible; no extra houses or trees.
review: Actual walking into and out of both changed courts
notClaimed: A completed photoreal town, fully open private gardens or furnished interiors.
